page.layout: One page of running text, with short notes in smaller type set below it in full lines (two type="foot" paragraphs). Then the word FINIS and a printer's mark, and a decorative ornament below. No margins with text.

main_text.p: vero est λοιμὸν esse pestem, λιμὸν famem. quare lubricus eo magis lapsus est.

pag. 38. lin. 3. Σαρμάτωνος.[?] Dinido, quae coalita, δ᾽ Αρμάτωνος. Theophylactus ipse infra suis verbis, legatione V. Romanorum ad barbaros: ὁ βασιλεὺς προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν Αρμάτωνα πρέσβιν χειροτονεῖ.
lin.10. Αναρχίδ᾽ τ᾽ Κνιδί᾽ς[?] Lege, Αγαθαρχίδς[?]. &c.

p.i: Reliqua enim desiderantur, disiectain-ter chartas Commeli-nianas.

page.notes: The page is the last of a gathering, with the book's closing words FINIS, a small printer's mark (W) below FINIS, and a decorative woodcut ornament (fleuron) in the lower half. These are not text and are not transcribed. The Greek in the notes is hard to read at this scan resolution; the marked words (Σαρμάτωνος, Αναρχίδ᾽ τ᾽ Κνιδί᾽ς, Αγαθαρχίδς) are doubtful. The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page.
